sources: Fairchild (onsemi) 2N5088/2N5089/MMBT5088/MMBT5089 NPN General Purpose Amplifier, Rev A (2001), from onsemi https://www.onsemi.com/pdf/datasheet/2n5088-d.pdf (the Fairchild document onsemi serves), read 2026-10-31; LCSC C3201780 is onsemi 2N5088BU, TO-92 (JLCPCB catalogue 2026-10-31 (edakit part search): Extended Part, no stock)
pins 1 emitter, 2 base, 3 collector: the designs' symbol Transistor_BJT:2N3904 (1 E, 2 B, 3 C) with the value 2N5088 and the footprint TO-92_Inline; p. 1 draws the TO-92's leads E, B, C

vce_max_v 30, veb_max_v 4.5, ic_max_a 0.1, tj_max_c 150, t_min_c −55: p. 1 absolute maximum ratings of the 2N5088 (VCBO 35 V has no field); p_max_w 0.625, rth_ja_k_per_w 200: p. 1 thermal characteristics
hfe_min 300: p. 2 DC current gain minimum at 100 µA and 10 mA (350 at 1 mA); hfe_max 900: at 100 µA, the only maximum

vce_sat_v 0.5: p. 2 at IC = 10 mA, IB = 1.0 mA; icbo_a 50 nA at 25 °C: p. 2 ICBO maximum at VCB = 20 V (the typical curve of p. 4 rises from 0.12 nA at 25 °C to about 2.5 nA at 125 °C – not a maximum, not entered)

spice: assumption – Gummel-Poon fitted by Claude to the typical curves of p. 4, no manufacturer model read: BF 600 (typical pulsed hFE at 25 °C, about 540 / 600 / 560 at 0.1 / 1 / 10 mA, read from the graph); IS 8.2 fA from the base-emitter on voltage, about 0.66 V at 1 mA (read from the graph); IKF 0.04 A for the fall of the gain above 10 mA
notes: High-gain, low-noise NPN in TO-92: the Classic Boost's single common-emitter stage. Open-design transcription.
